step_by_step_reasoning: CloudWatch Events trigger a Step Functions workflow on a schedule. Step Functions coordinate three Lambda functions: the first checks for new drone images on a third-party server via an API; the second downloads these images and saves them to Amazon S3; the third creates raster proxies pointing to S3 and writes them to the local database of an on-premises mapping server. The on-premises server subsequently accesses the image files in S3 transparently via AWS Storage Gateway.
